svg.title: Now approximate the plane Killing field xaeb −xbea by compactly supported smooth vector fields. Choose frequency widths λ−100 on axes a, b, λ−150 on the remaining line direction if present, and λ−300 on the other axes. An odd primitive in direction a, multiplied by λ100, and its partner with a, b interchanged give the two components. Their derivatives in the a, b pair agree exactly. Since Jab = Jba, these two terms in P i,j ∂iFjJij cancel before any integral is split. The remaining derivatives are supported outside the insertion neighborhoods, where no contact term is present.
